title: MegaEssentialsLite
description: MegaEssentialsLite is a lightweight but feature-packed Paper 1.21.x Essentials-style plugin with moderation, homes, warps, TPA, economy, GUI shop, Discord integration, maintenance mode, vanish, utility commands, and SQLite-backed data storage.
body:
**MegaEssentialsLite**

A lightweight but powerful **Essentials-style plugin for Paper 1.21.x**.

MegaEssentialsLite combines moderation, teleportation, economy, GUI shop, Discord integration, maintenance tools, and player utilities into one clean plugin with SQLite-backed storage.

**Features**

- Teleportation: /spawn, /home, /sethome, /warp, /tpa, /back, /rtp
- Moderation: /kick, /ban, /tempban, /mute, /warn, /report, /freeze
- Economy: balances, payments, /baltop, /ecohist, /sell, GUI /shop
- Discord: chat bridge, logging, slash commands, account linking, maintenance announcements
- Utilities: /nick, /realname, /afk, /ping, /hat, /speed, /serverstats
- Maintenance: server-wide and per-world maintenance with warnings and timers
- Storage: fully SQLite-backed, no external database required

**Optional hooks**

- LuckPerms
- PlaceholderAPI
- ProtocolLib
- Vault

**Built for**

- Paper 1.21.x
- Survival servers
- SMPs
- Community servers
- Economy-focused servers

**Why use it?**

MegaEssentialsLite is made for servers that want a **clean all-in-one core plugin** without running a huge stack of separate utility plugins.
